text_simplified: Parents must give tarbiyah (upbringing) to daughters and sons with justice, and not prefer sons over daughters. The tarbiyah of daughters is a great responsibility, and whoever dislikes daughters has opposed the command of Allah. Allah forbids the burying of daughters alive and honors them, and gratitude to Allah for the blessing of daughters is obligatory. The tarbiyah of daughters leads to safety and barakah (blessing) in the family.
